source:
@@U00412@@
Whatever I wear,
what is this earth but a prison,
a narrow, confining cell that denies me liberty!
Too old to do anything but play,
too young not to burn with desire,
what satisfaction can life offer?
translation:
@@U00412@@
无论我穿什么，
这个地球不过是一座监狱，
一个狭窄、封闭的牢房，剥夺了我的自由！
年纪大了除了玩什么都做不了
太年轻，不能不被欲望燃烧，
生活能带来什么满足？
